V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The central 'round lawn' is bounded by the street wall to the north, the building to the east, and dense planting to the west and south, creating a clearly defined and enclosed outdoor room.

V-FOCAL.evidence: Large canopy tree (P-SAU-02) at the north end of the round lawn, with a smaller Punica tree isolated on the far left.

V-AXIS.evidence: No distinct paths are drawn; circulation is implied through the open round lawn connecting the street edge to the sunken seat and side court seating areas.

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Multiple groups of identical-sized circles (shrubs) are arranged in linear rows along the top and bottom boundaries, and a cluster of three similar circles sits centrally, indicating clear repetition and massing.

V-LAYERING.evidence: Plan shows canopy trees (dark green), small trees (medium green), shrubs (light green), and ground/perennials (pale green) layered together, particularly in the central and lower-left planting beds.

V-ROOMS.evidence: Plan shows a 'side court' with grid paving, a central 'round lawn', and a 'sunken seat' area with distinct paving, creating multiple defined zones.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear spatial structure with defined rooms (round lawn, side court, sunken seat), strong planting masses along the street and south edge, and distinct paving/lawn zones creating a cohesive, designed composition.
